content: This information is not intended to serve as personalized medical advice and should not replace the guidance of your healthcare professional. Always consult your healthcare provider for comprehensive information about this product and your specific health needs. In the United States, contact your doctor for medical advice regarding side effects. Similarly, in Canada, reach out to your doctor for advice on side effects. In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, immediately call 911. If the situation is less urgent, contact a poison control center without delay. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222 for assistance. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless explicitly instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it has expired or is no longer needed. The information provided here was last updated in May 2024. It is important to note that this is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. This information does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or suitable for your use. Always seek advice from your healthcare professional for complete and individualized information about this product and your health requirements. Adding plans allows you to compare the formulary status of this product with other drugs in the same class. To access formulary information, first create a list of plans. This list will be saved and can be edited at any time. Individual plans may vary, and formulary information is subject to change. Contact the relevant plan provider for the most up-to-date information. The above information is provided for general informational and educational purposes only.
